title: Classified DoD payloads as evidence of a secret space program

tellings.quote:
we know
that at Vandenberg Air Force bases there
are classified payloads that are
launched into space routinely.

plain: A guest named Maaneli Derakhshani points to the secret Pentagon cargo launched from Vandenberg Air Force Base as a sign that the government may run a hidden space programme. Without naming a source, he tells Michels that "there are classified payloads that are launched into space routinely" from the base. If he is right, a good deal of what goes into space would be out of public view.
